2609.11155.title: DRG-MAPPO: Hierarchical Dynamic Role-Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Air Combat
2609.11155.paper_summary: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for complex decision-making in autonomous systems and air combat. While MARL has demonstrated significant potential in air combat, achieving sophisticated tactical coordination remains a non-trivial challenge. This difficulty is largely attributed to two primary limitations: (1) the absence of structured relational modeling hinders agents from capturing complex, time-varying interactions among battlefield entities; and (2) conventional flat architectures often lack the capability to explicitly model tactical roles, leading to ambiguous task allocation in highly dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Dynamic Role-Graph Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (DRG-MAPPO), a novel MARL framework that integrates graph-based relational modeling with dynamic role assignment. Specifically, DRG-MAPPO constructs a graph-based representation of battlefield interactions and leverages graph attention mechanisms to extract critical relational features among allies, enemies, and threats. Subsequently, a high-level policy employs a dynamic role assignment mechanism to determine tactical responsibilities (e.g., ``leader'' and ``supporter''). Conditioned on these roles and encoded graph-relational features, a low-level policy executes discrete maneuver actions, facilitating the joint optimization of tactical strategy and collaborative execution. Furthermore, a target-priority auxiliary task is designed to foster the emergence of behaviors such as focus-fire. Experimental results demonstrate that DRG-MAPPO achieves a state-of-the-art win rate of 87%, suggesting that our framework effectively balances relational modeling, interpretability, and optimization stability for cooperative air combat.
2609.11155.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體強化學習（MARL）已成為自主系統和空中戰鬥中複雜決策的重要範式。雖然MARL在空中戰鬥中展現了顯著的潛力，但實現精緻的戰術協調仍然是一項非平凡的挑戰。這一困難主要歸因於兩個主要限制：（1）缺乏結構化的關聯建模使得智能體無法捕捉戰場實體之間複雜且隨時間變化的互動；（2）傳統的平面架構通常缺乏明確建模戰術角色的能力，導致在高度動態環境中任務分配模糊。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了層級動態角色圖多智能體近端策略優化（DRG-MAPPO），這是一個新穎的MARL框架，將基於圖的關聯建模與動態角色分配相結合。具體而言，DRG-MAPPO構建了戰場互動的基於圖的表示，並利用圖注意力機制提取盟友、敵人和威脅之間的重要關聯特徵。隨後，高層政策採用動態角色分配機制來確定戰術責任（例如，“領導者”和“支持者”）。根據這些角色和編碼的圖關聯特徵，低層政策執行離散的機動行動，促進戰術策略和協作執行的聯合優化。此外，設計了一個目標優先輔助任務，以促進如集中火力等行為的出現。實驗結果表明，DRG-MAPPO實現了87%的最先進勝率，這表明我們的框架有效平衡了關聯建模、可解釋性和優化穩定性，以實現協作空中戰鬥。
